sbc1g.objective: Make silent drift of the frozen foundation detectable in ordinary PR/push CI and preserve permanent regression coverage.
sbc1g.primary_permanent_ci: Codemagic pull_request/push guards for main on Mac/Apple and Windows
sbc1g.github_actions_role: manual fallback; pull-request runner startup was unavailable during candidate preparation
mandatory: critical dependency versions and reviewed native Cargo.lock enforced
permanent regressions cover GBP, hard reopen, duplicate OFX, reversal/audit, documents and encryption
Windows production Tauri shell compile check
dependency changes require regenerated SBOM, licence register and adjudication evidence
sbc1g.pass: ordinary changes cannot silently drift the frozen foundation

sbc1h.objective: Adjudicate SBC-1A through SBC-1G as one closed platform/foundation phase with no unapproved frozen-boundary change.
required_outputs: updated programme state, architecture, roadmap and library index

forbidden_scope: OCR or receipt matching feature implementation
App Store signing or release distribution
dependency upgrade without explicit foundation-change review
